test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Staringg."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Staring"** with only one **"g"** at the end. • The extra **"g" **in option 2 makes it the incorrectly spelled word. • The word **"staring" **means to look at somebody or something for a long time because you are surprised, shocked, etc. ((आश्‍चर्य, विक्षोभ आदि के कारण) किसी को देर तक देखते रहना; घूरना, टकटकी लगा कर देखना) • **Example**: *Robin sat **staring**__ into space, her mind numb.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** __ • **Grave**: a noun meaning a place of burial for a dead body. (क़ब्र) • **Example**: *He visited his grandfather's **grave**__.* • **Leaf**: a noun meaning the flattened structure of a plant that is attached to a stem or branch. (पौधे या वृक्ष का पत्ता) __ • **Example**: *The tree's **leaves**__ turned yellow in the fall.* • **Blame**: a verb meaning to assign responsibility for a fault or wrong. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ग़लती का ज़िम्‍मेदार या दोषी ठहराना) __ • **Example**: *She didn't want to **blame**__ anyone for the accident.* 1c8:T69b, The correct answer is **"times of natural."**
